home.sheetHowTitle: How Saath works in 3 calm steps
home.sheetHowBody: 1. Verify your PNR or boarding pass without saving raw passenger names. 2. Pick who in your party wants to move or sit together. 3. Agree on a swap, get a signed Swap Card, and confirm after arrival.
home.sheetSafetyBody: Co-travellers only see your coach and berth type before mutual accept. Women-only matching is enforced server-side, and emergency links (139 / 182) stay one tap away.
home.sheetToolsBody: Train PNR aggregates, chart preparation times, coach positions, and aircraft seat maps are available right inside your Journey Hub.
home.sheetFaqBody: Is Saath free? Yes—peer-to-peer seat swaps are ₹0 forever. Seats are never bought or auctioned.

pnrStatus.metaDescription: Check 10-digit Indian Railways PNR booking & berth aggregates without storing names or phone numbers, then find verified seat swaps on Saath.

pnrStatus.faq1Q: Does Saath store passenger names when checking PNR status?
pnrStatus.faq1A: No. Saath strips passenger names, ages, and personal identifiers and displays only booking and berth-type aggregates.
pnrStatus.faq2Q: Can I swap my berth after checking my PNR?
pnrStatus.faq2A: Yes! Tap Find a swap or Be open to help to match privately with verified co-travellers on your train.

trainLive.faq1A: Trains departing between 05:00 and 14:00 IST prepare charts at 20:00 IST the previous evening; other trains prepare charts 10 hours before departure.

trainChartTime.title: Train {trainNo} Chart Preparation Time
trainChartTime.ruleMorning: Morning window (05:00–14:00 IST departure): first chart prepares at 20:00 IST the previous evening.
trainChartTime.ruleStandard: Standard rule: first chart prepares 10 hours before scheduled departure.
trainChartTime.faq1Q: What if my berth changes when the final chart is prepared?
trainChartTime.faq1A: Saath monitors chart changes automatically and revokes outdated Swap Cards so no one gets confused onboard.

flightSeatMap.title: {airline} {aircraft} Seat Map
flightSeatMap.faq1Q: Are exit-row seats eligible for every passenger?
flightSeatMap.faq1A: No. DGCA safety rules restrict exit-row seats to able-bodied adults; Saath marks exit rows clearly on the cabin map.
